$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what is live vs coming-soon across ALL Gully RPC surfaces (landing, portal, status page, docs). Edit this file to flip a surface as reality changes; never hardcode live/coming-soon claims anywhere else. status enum: live | syncing | coming-soon | beta. As of 2026-10-26: open beta (sign-up open to everyone); 5 chains served through a partner RPC network, own nodes in progress.
